labels.name: 6.topic: rust

labels.description: This PR does not cause any packages to rebuild on Darwin.

items.body:
enables patterns like
```
tree-sitter.overrideAttrs (prevAttrs: {
  version = "0.25.10";
  src = prevAttrs.src.overrideAttrs {
    hash = "sha256-aHszbvLCLqCwAS4F4UmM3wbSb81QuG9FM7BDHTu1ZvM=";
  };
  cargoHash = "sha256-4R5Y9yancbg/w3PhACtsWq0+gieUd2j8YnmEj/5eqkg=";
  patches = [];
})
```

whereas previously this would not behave as expected, e.g. `cargoDeps` would be built against the un-overriden `cargoHash`, and then the outer derivation would fail when checking the vendored cargo deps against its override `cargoHash`.

items.title: `cargoHash` might be different on linux and darwin systems

labels.name: 0.kind: bug
labels.description: Something is broken

labels.name: 6.topic: darwin
labels.description: Running or building packages on Darwin

labels.name: 6.topic: rust
labels.description: General-purpose programming language emphasizing performance, type safety, and concurrency.

labels.name: 2.status: stale
labels.description: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/master/.github/STALE-BOT.md

items.body:
### Describe the bug
The `cargoHash` might be different on linux and darwin systems.  I know that [kanata], [atuin] and [trunk-ng] have this problem.  There are [more affected packages][more].

This problem seems to be caused by the [case sensitivity][cause] of file systems.

Enabling `useFetchCargoVendor` solves this.

[kanata]: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/306546
[atuin]: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/224411
[trunk-ng]: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/276488
[cause]: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/306546#discussion_r1584771680
[more]: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/306546#discussion_r1584378508

### Additional context
- `buildGoModule` solves [a similar problem][go] using `proxyVendor`.
- related upstream issues:
  - https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/issues/13722
  - https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/issues/14020
- workarounds in Nixpkgs
  - [kanata](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/e4ca168c1baaaf05f3ad338d3826bab16d4f6c40/pkgs/tools/system/kanata/default.nix#L25-L44): not needed any more after [switching](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/commit/93f86b0dfebe49aadce23835ebd1448db9346f7f) to `useFetchCargoVendor`
  - [samply](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/4877ea239f4d02410c3516101faf35a81af0c30e/pkgs/development/tools/misc/samply/default.nix#L21-L42)
  - [slippy](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/4877ea239f4d02410c3516101faf35a81af0c30e/pkgs/applications/misc/slippy/default.nix#L25-L44): not needed any more after [switching](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/commit/100e36aa2f71dade7c02960eed64c1e5b9ff8c3c) to `useFetchCargoVendor`
  - [atuin](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/53d915d81fd74d2ae8bd3eebcaa03958d684afba/pkgs/by-name/at/atuin/package.nix#L26-L50): not needed any more after [switching](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/commit/668b7e734d6373350de1466fe9e6272f2ab94391) to `useFetchCargoVendor`

[go]: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/issues/129730

### Notify maintainers

@NixOS/rust

```
         specified: sha256-LfLqScEqBJK9s+xRg2Ah1OnBEDQjXQ9LgJGusmxEDfk=
            got:    sha256-VrxoxygLkw+77ORgFnFmIVY4CRVgWevWkiFcYxiPkpw=
```

## Cause

restate has git dependencies with submodules. nix-prefetch-git --fetch-submodules fetches them non-deterministically, causing hash mismatches.

## Git Dependencies

- base62-2.2.3
- raft-0.7.0, raft-proto-0.7.0
- rdkafka-0.38.0, rdkafka-sys-4.9.0+2.12.1
- restate-web-ui-0.1.49
- rust-librocksdb-sys-0.41.0+10.9.1, rust-rocksdb-0.45.0
- sasl2-sys-0.1.22+2.1.28

items.body:
cargoHash produces non-deterministic hashes due to nix-prefetch-git fetching git dependencies with submodules. Switch to cargoLock with explicit outputHashes for reproducible builds.

fixes #525097
